environment.location: Oxford Mine Adits - Lower Collapse Zone (Exit Junction)
environment.description: A damp, cavernous mine shaft exit junction. The massive chassis of Silt-Marrow the Unhewn lies completely inert, dismantled, and harvested. The seismic rumbles have ceased, leaving the air still except for settling dust. Clear ascent routes lead upward via the ore-cart track toward the Washington Borough Safe-Zone, and downward toward the Morris Canal Aqueducts.
